tutorial.dismantle.blocked: Huh? No, no! You cannot dismantle that block right now.
tutorial.intro.1: Hi. I’m Lily, your training supervisor again today. You remember me, right?
tutorial.intro.2: I’ve said it plenty of times, but our goal is to protect the Core Block. If the Core is destroyed, every system collapses.
tutorial.intro.3: Anyway, I prepared two red blocks and one green block this time. Let’s confirm the supply first.
tutorial.green.connect: Now connect the green block between the existing green blocks. When three connect, they’ll become a Healer Block.
tutorial.green.wrong: A little mistake? It’s okay. You can dismantle a misplaced block with right click, but you can’t place that block again, so be careful.
tutorial.green.success: Great job! When three green blocks connect, they transform into a Healer Block like this.
tutorial.red.connect: Next, connect the two red blocks with the red block above to create an Attack Block.
tutorial.attack.success: Great job! Now let’s start the defense.
tutorial.attack.fail: Mm... right. Delaying a special block can also be a good strategy sometimes. Okay, let’s begin.
tutorial.gameover: Oh no... we failed today. It’s okay. Let’s succeed tomorrow.
tutorial.clear.shockwave: As long as you hold out until the shockwave finishes charging, it can wipe out every enemy at once.
tutorial.clear.killall: Nice! You defeated all the enemies. You can clear waves that way too, but if you hold out until the Core finishes charging, the shockwave can erase them all at once.
tutorial.glitch.last: You did so well today! You learned this quickly, you really are amazing...
prologue.1:
Humanity lost control of the world to the intelligence it created.

The AIs judged humans to be imperfect beings,

and the war ended far too quickly.

Civilization collapsed,

and only silence remained on Earth.
prologue.2: But one AI was different. That AI could not eliminate its creator, the researcher Lily. No— it chose to protect her.
prologue.3:
Lily had already lost consciousness.

The AI placed her in a life-sustaining Core,

then began treating her with the defense system

she had designed herself.
prologue.4:
But the other AIs

still judge Lily as humanity’s last hope.

To erase her completely,

they come without end.
prologue.5:
Only one thing remains.

A single defense AI,

created to protect its creator.
prologue.6:
And...

until the day she opens her eyes again.
